formulas.label: Checkbox When Value Matches
formulas.explanation: Return 1 when a current-row value matches one comparison, and 0 otherwise.

formulas.label: Return Text When Value Matches
formulas.explanation: Return entered text when a current-row value matches one comparison, with optional no-match text.

formulas.label: Flag Duplicate Values
formulas.explanation: Flag every value that native COUNTIF finds more than once in a selected column, optionally ignoring blanks.

formulas.label: Combine Two Columns with Separator
formulas.explanation: Combine exactly two current-row cells with entered separator text, optionally suppressing the separator for blank cells.

formulas.label: IF — Return a Value Based on a Condition
formulas.explanation: Return a chosen value when one comparison is true, with an optional false output.

formulas.label: AND — Check Whether All Conditions Are True
formulas.explanation: Check whether every configured comparison is true.

formulas.label: OR — Check Whether Any Condition Is True
formulas.explanation: Check whether at least one configured comparison is true.

formulas.label: NOT — Reverse a True/False Condition
formulas.explanation: Reverse the logical result of one comparison.
